rows.title_full: AN ACT ADJUSTING THE AMOUNTS OF PERSONAL EXEMPTIONS AND MINIMUM TAXABLE INCOME TO BE MORE RELEVANT TO THE CURRENT COST OF LIVING
rows.abstract: Seeks to make the amount of personal eemption at par with the current cost of living. Proposes the following scheme of personeal exemptions: (1) P9,000.00 for single individual or legally separated individual with no qualified dependents. (2) P18,000.00 for head of the family; (3) P18,000.00 for married individual; (4) P18,000.00 for each husband and wife electing to derive taxable income otherwise only the spouse deriving taxable income can avail of the exemption; and (5) P5,000.00 per qualified dependent children not exceeding four.
rows.status: Substituted by HB09077

rows.title_full: AN ACT TO INSTILL DISCIPLINE AMONG THE MEMBERS OF THE PHILIPPINE NATIONAL POLICE BY EMPOWERING THE NATIONAL POLICE COMMISSION TO OVERSEE  ITS INTERNAL ADMINISTRATIVE MACHINERY, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Declares that the National Police Commission (NAPOLCOM) shall decide cases on appeal from decisions rendered by the REGIONAL NAPOLCOM OFFICES. The NAPOLCOM Regional Offices shall acquire EXCLUSIVE ORIGINAL JURISDICTION over any complaint by an individual person against any member of the PNP.  The offenses covered are those punishable by (1) withholding of privileges; (2) restriction to specified limits; (3) suspension or forfeiture of salary.

rows.title_full: AN ACT CREATING COUNCILS FOR THE PROTECTION OF CHILDREN IN EVERY CITY AND MUNICIPALITY OF THE PHILIPPINES, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Supports the policy of the State to bring up its minor citizens with proper direction, supervision and guardianship in their training, education and other interests. Creates a Council for the Protection of children within the city or municipality which shall among other functions: (1) encourage the cultivation of the duties of parents; (2) protect and assist abandoned or mistreated children and orphans; (3) take stpes to prevent juvenile deliquency.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on SOCIAL SERVICES since 1996-05-07

rows.title_full: AN ACT INCREASING THE PENSION OF FORMER PRESIDENTS OF THE REPUBLIC OF THE PHILIPPINES OR THEIR SURVIVING SPOUSES, TO HELP INSURE THAT THEY LIVE IN CONDITIONS OF DIGNITY, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE REPUBLIC ACT NUMBERED FIFTY HUNDRED AND FIFTY-NINE, ASAMENDED, AND REPUBLIC ACT NUMBERED TWENTY HUNDRED AND EIGHTY-SEVEN, AS AMENDED
rows.abstract: INcreases the life pension of every former President of the Philippines and their surviving spouses from [ninety-six thousand pesos (P96,000.00) annually payable at the rate of eight thousand pesos (P8,000.00) monthly] to a SUM EQUIVALENT TO THE ANNUAL SALARY OF THE INCUMBENT PRESIDENT AT THE TIME OF REMITTANCE, PAYABLE MONTHLY IN TWELVE EQUAL INSTALLMENTS.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on APPROPRIATIONS since 1996-05-07

rows.title_full: AN ACT GRANTING FRANKING PRIVILEGE TO THE OFFICE OF THE PUNONG BARANGAY AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Seeks to grant franking privilege to the Office of the Punong Barangay on all OFFICIAL communications in order to provide a prompt and immediate response to the needs of the barangays and their residents. Provides that all mails of the Office shallbe given priority by post offices and mail distribution centers.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on TRANSPORTATION AND COMMUNICATIONS since 1996-05-07

rows.author: A103
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO INSTITUTE THE POLICIES ON THE LOCAL ADOPTION OF FILIPINO CHILDREN
rows.abstract: Declares that the State shall adopt the tenets set forth in the UN Declaration and UN Convention on the Rights of the Child that the BEST INTERESTS OF THE CHILD shall be the paramount consideration in the adoption of Filipino children. Declares further that in considering the child's best interest, the State shall be guided by the UN Declaration on Social and Legal Principles relating to the Protection and Welfare of Chidlren with Special Reference to Foster Placement and Adoption Nationally and Internationally .
rows.status: Substituted by HB10378

rows.title_full: AN ACT TO EXEMPT CERTAIN INCOME FROM TAXATION, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE PARAGRAPH (b) OF SECTION TWENTY-EIGHT, CHAPTER FOUR, TITLE TWO OF THE NATIONAL INTERNAL REVENUE CODE OF 1986, AS AMENDED
rows.abstract: EXEMPTS the following income from the computation of the GROSS compensation income: (1) overtime pay of employees in the First Level Positions of the Career Service of the Civil Service, and those employees in the private sector belonging to the non-supervisory group; (2) medical compensation benefits; and (3) income other than basic wages, such as proceeds from profit-sharing, allowances, accumulated leaves, commissions and other benefits paud to an employee, in cash or in kind.

rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE SUPPORT INFRASTRUCTURES TO IDENTIFIED GROWTH CENTERS THROUGHOUT THE COUNTRY
rows.abstract: Provides for the creation of support infrastructures for industrial growth centers, as identified by the National Economic Development Authority (NEDA) in different parts of the country, to be undertaken by the Department of Trade and Industry (DTI), in coordination with other appropriate government agencies. Enumerates the support infrastructure to be undertaken in this Act as: (1) Concrete Road Network and Water Supply (2) Power Supply; (3) Telecommunicati ons Facilities; (4) Airport (5) PortFacilities; and (6) Water Supply.

rows.abstract: "Family and Medical Leave Act of 1996" Grants an employee, whether employed in a private or government entity, a Family and Medical Leave when his legitimate spouse, parent, or legitimate unmarried child suffers from serious illness, which benefit an employee may also supply for the same if he himself is physically unable to perform his job due to a serious illness.

rows.title_full: AN ACT TO PROVIDE AN EFFECTIVE ASSISTANCE DELIVERY SYSTEM TO ADDRESS THE PRODUCTION AND TECHNOLOGY NEEDS OF COTTAGE, SMALL AND MEDIUM ENTERPRISES AND STRENGTHEN THE COTTAGE INDUSTRY TECHNOLOGY CENTER WHICH IS HEREBY RENAMED AS THE PRODUCTIVITY INSTITUTE FOR COTTAGE, SMALL AND MEDIUM ENTERPRISES, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES

rows.title_full: AN ACT TO GOVERN SAFEGUARD MEASURES TO BE TAKEN IN RESPONSE TO AN INCREASE IN THE IMPORTATION OF GOODS DIRECTLY RESULTING OUT OF THE OBLIGATIONS INCLUDING TARIFF CONCESSIONS UNDER THE WTO (anti-dumping)
rows.abstract: "Safeguard Measure Act of 1996" Provides safeguard measures to protect local industries from injury or threat of injury directly attributable to the increased importation of articles subject to the obligations including tariff consessions made underthe World Trade Organization (WTO). Provides, further for the specific agricultural commodities whose quantitative restrictions were converted into ordinary customs duties and import volumes of which have increased or the import prices of which havedecreased, as provided in the General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade (GATT) of 1994, the Agreement on Safeguards, the Agreement in Agriculture of the WTO.
rows.status: Bill reconsidered on1997-10-01

coauthors.name: DE LA CRUZ, ZOILO JR. V.

second_reading.reasons: To give way to some interpella tions.

rows.title_full: AN ACT TO PROTECT DOMESTIC INDUSTRIES FROM UNFAIR COMPETITION BROUGHT ABOUT BY THE PRESENCE OF PRODUCTION AND/OR EXPORT SUBSIDIES AMENDING FOR THAT PURPOSE SECTION 302 ON COUNTERVAILING DUTY OF THE TARIFFS AND CUSTOMS CODE OF THE PHILIPPINES
rows.abstract: Puts into place the built-in safety nets of the World Trade Organization (WTO) through an amendment to repeal the provisions of Section 302 and align it with that of the Uruguay Round (UR) Agreement on Subsidies and Countervailing Duties (SCM). Transfers part of the administrative functions of the Department of Finance (DOF) and the Tariff Commission to the Department of Trade and Industries (DTI) to implement Section 302, particularly in the receiving of applications for investigation, the conduct of the preliminary investigation and the decision to impose the preliminary countervailing duties (CVDs), and the final decision to impose a definitive CVD.
rows.status: Substituted by HB08907

rows.abstract: Seeks to safeguard the PROPERTY RIGHTS of Filipino artists and their artistic creations on cases of REPLAYS and RERUNS of local television shows.
